example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কঠোর পরিশ্রমের ফলে সে অবশেষে রাজমুকুট লাভ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: After his hard work, he finally attained the royal position.
The new leader has taken the crown of power.
history: This idiom draws from historical concepts of monarchy in Bengal and ancient Indian kingdoms, where the crown symbolized sovereignty and authority passed down through rulers.
note: Refers metaphorically to achieving or holding a supreme position of power, akin to becoming a king.
